name: Test Lamp
soul: The soul of no one: a test lamp, kept for the engine's tests only.
spark: A test mote, kept for the engine's tests only.

hybrid.text: It is a test of the test lamp.

settled.name: Small test lamp
settled.text: A test settled form of the test lamp, kept for the engine's tests only.
settled.sign: A stranger would notice the mark of Small test lamp on it.
settled.habit: When nothing is happening, Small test lamp counts to itself.
